PreceptDef.label: small
PreceptDef.description: Large rooms and caverns remind us too much of the dangerous outdoors. We prefer tight, cramped accomodations.

li.label: confined interior
li.description: This space is wonderfully tiny. I feel safe and comfortable surrounded by solid walls.

li.label: cramped interior
li.description: This room is perfectly snug. There's no need for all that wasted space.

li.label: spacious interior
li.description: This room is far too expansive. All this empty space makes me feel exposed.
